project.name: Importer: LOINC
project.description: Imports the LOINC release (Regenstrief's Loinc.csv, Part.csv and ComponentHierarchyBySystem.csv) into the running store: parts, components and LOINC codes with their names, identifiers, status, class, example units and test-membership annotations, and each code's definition by its six axes as an OWL axiom transformed into an EL++ stated axiom. Ported from IKM's loinc-data transformation and starter-data plugins onto the store writer.
